notes:
Summary: Fintech payments platform (user-facing chat + transaction reranking) with strict latency and cost targets. Primary ask = help design inference footprint that meets p50/p95 latency targets while minimizing per-token cost. Interested in Redwood Optimize guidance (batching/caching/quant) and an apples-to-apples perf benchmark with their existing on-prem cluster.

Key constraints / priorities:
- Latency: target p50 ~ 30-50ms, p95 <= 120ms for conversational routing + rerank flows. Backend throughput target: sustained 400-600 qps across peak windows.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering leadership wants projected monthly inference spend < $0.10 per active user (modeling variable).
- Model preference: open weights (Llama-2 family or Mistral variants) but willing to adopt Redwood-verified quantized variants.
- Routing: need policy-based routing by customer tier + regional residency; on-fallback must degrade to smaller quantized model with graceful token budget reduction.
- Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency breakdowns, KV cache hit rate metric critical for their SLOs.
- Compliance: SOC2 in place, require audit logs + KMS for key material; EU residency for EU customers.

Notes from calls (shorthand):
- "can't exceed 120ms p95 for chat or ops will block" — head of infra.
- SE wants access to batch latency histograms and kernel selection logs to validate quant performance.
- Interested in continuous batching vs shard-level batching tradeoffs; worried about higher tail latency from large buckets.
- Asking Redwood to run perf benchmarks vs their current Triton-based stack (on prem A100s) and provide expected cost delta for int8/int4 quantization.

POC plan (agreed):
- 2-week controlled POC using Dedicated pool with one model family (70B quantized candidate + 13B fallback).
- Redwood to provide perf matrix (p50/p95/p99), cost-per-token, KV cache hit rates, and suggested batch sizes per percentile.
- QuarkFlow will provide representative prompt set + production-like traffic replay (anonymized).

Open action items / blockers:
- Procurement needs final pricing and SOW (Maya preparing draft).
- Legal needs data residency/KMS language (requested security FAQ from Redwood).
- SE requires kernel-level logs (Ravi to check with infra on what we can expose for POC).

Stated win conditions:
- Demonstrate p95 <= 120ms with cost reduction >= 30% vs current on-prem baseline for chat/re-ranking mix.
- Clear rollout plan for canary -> A/B -> full migration with fallback rules.

Quote / direct: "If you can show 30% savings without >1.5% accuracy drop on rerank, we'll move to a 12-month Dedicated commitment." — Head of Product.
